adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` (new file `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the raw `Response` without any timeout/AbortController and without checking `response.ok`. This means a hung sync endpoint can stall the request indefinitely, and non-2xx responses are passed onward. Call sites then treat the returned value like a successful token payload (e.g., GoogleCalendarService does `const token = res?.data;` after calling `refreshOAuthTokens`), so error/HTML/500 responses won’t be rejected at this layer and can be mis-handled as if they were valid.
